payload.title: The doc-staleness adapter has no claimed role for an ADR Status header (Proposed, Draft, Superseded), a dated or Historical heading at the top of a document, a plan-table Create row, or a planned, pending or (R2) marker, so a reference under any of them is reported as a stale claim although the document says the path is not live
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:122-156 (UnclaimedRole is creation, proposal, absence or change_target; the pattern lists hold no planned, pending, release-marker or Status header pattern)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:131-135 (CREATION_RES matches (new), a dash then new, and a list-item Create: only; a table row whose cell reads Create is not matched)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:137-140 (PROPOSAL_RES reads the word proposed or proposal, and only inside the reference's own markdown unit)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:246-271 (referenceRole decides the role from the reference's own unit and nothing above it, so a document-level Status line is never seen)

tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:325-349 (isPointInTimeRecord keys on an archive path, a reviews or audits path segment, a dated path segment, or ARIA-HISTORICAL or ARIA-SUPERSEDED in the first 5 lines; a dated or Historical heading is not a key)
tools/aria-adapters/fixtures/doc-staleness-adapter/cases/semantic-reference-roles.json (the roles fixture holds no case for a Status header, a Create table row or a planned, pending or (R2) marker)
payload.rule_violated: The doc-staleness rule claims that a document answers confidently about a surface that is gone (the adapter's own header, ARIA-HIGH-212): a document that says the path is proposed, planned or historical makes no such claim, so a role the adapter cannot read is a false claim it judges
payload.notes: Probed at origin/main db10640f6 by calling the adapter's own referenceRole and isPointInTimeRecord: a reference in a document whose header reads Status: Proposed or Status: Superseded, a plan-table row | Create | `path` |, and list items marked (planned), pending migration or (R2) all return no role, while (new) returns creation and the word proposed returns proposal; isPointInTimeRecord returns false for a document headed Historical inventory with a date and for one whose first lines read Status: Superseded. Each such reference is therefore emitted as a stale claim and sent to the judges, which is the false-positive class ARIA-HIGH-212 (open, owner of the 0.85 precision gate) tracks. A peer session measured it on origin/main 3a0cce89c and reported it (this finding states the figures as reported, the program did not re-run them): 273 findings, 28 with a planned, pending or (R2)-like marker nearby; a 60-item systematic sample labelled by two blind LLM labellers agreed 57 of 60, 11 of 60 were worth fixing (Wilson 0.106 to 0.299) and 4 of 60 were mechanically fixable (0.026 to 0.159). Close condition: These roles are claimed roles: referenceRole claims a planned, pending or (R2) marker and a Create table row, and isPointInTimeRecord (or a document-level role) claims an ADR Status header of Proposed, Draft or Superseded and a dated or Historical heading in the first lines; semantic-reference-roles.json and semantic-point-in-time-records.json each gain a positive fixture per role and a near-miss fixture (a live reference in a document that merely mentions the word) that still reports a finding. Plan row: F2.2. Verified at origin/main db10640f6.
